structure_name: Unrelated vendor fee then independent reinvestment
test: Fee is for actual producer/vendor services genuinely performed
required_evidence: Signed service contract; deliverables log; timesheets/invoices
failure_consequence: Fee is non-qualifying re-charge under TDM §3.3.4

structure_name: Unrelated vendor fee then independent reinvestment
test: Cost incurred wholly exclusively and necessarily to produce the film
required_evidence: Budget line justification; production accounts
failure_consequence: Cost excluded from total cost of production

structure_name: Unrelated vendor fee then independent reinvestment
test: Rate reflects what independent parties would agree absent the reinvestment
required_evidence: Market rate comparison; comparable-deal evidence
failure_consequence: Fee reduced to market rate or disallowed as inflated

structure_name: Unrelated vendor fee then independent reinvestment
test: Fee is fixed and unconditional not tied to film receipts earnings or profits
required_evidence: Contract silent on/excludes profit contingency
failure_consequence: Fee wholly excluded from qualifying expenditure

structure_name: Unrelated vendor fee then independent reinvestment
test: Real cash movement not book entry or set-off
required_evidence: Bank statements showing transfer
failure_consequence: Fee treated as unpaid/deferred and disallowed

structure_name: Unrelated vendor fee then independent reinvestment
test: No contract side-letter or understanding conditioning the fee on reinvestment
required_evidence: Written confirmation of no linkage; separate dated equity subscription documents
failure_consequence: Recharacterized as a single integrated arrangement; moves to S5 disposition

structure_name: Related-party producer/overhead fee then reinvestment into same production
test: Fee reflects services typical of a producer in the relevant market segment
required_evidence: Role description matching TDM §6.10 Producers Unit categories
failure_consequence: Fee disallowed under WEN test

structure_name: Related-party producer/overhead fee then reinvestment into same production
test: Fee <=15% of global budget (eligible expenditure >80% of budget) or <=10% (below 80%) or substantiated if higher
required_evidence: Global budget calculation; substantiation memo if exceeding parameter
failure_consequence: Excess portion disallowed

structure_name: Related-party producer/overhead fee then reinvestment into same production
test: If payment to connected person(s) >=30% of specified amount, disclose identity, services, and amount
required_evidence: Compliance report Schedule 5 Tab C(e) disclosure
authority_citation: Film Regulations 2019 Sch. 5 Tab C(e); TCA 1997 s.10 (connected)
failure_consequence: Compliance report deficient; claim exposed to withdrawal

structure_name: Related-party producer/overhead fee then reinvestment into same production
test: Commercial rate and evidence services were actually performed by the connected party
required_evidence: Contract; deliverables; rate benchmarking per TDM Part 04-06-23 principles
failure_consequence: Excess over commercial rate disallowed

structure_name: Related-party producer/overhead fee then reinvestment into same production
test: Financing/corporate structure has a commercial rationale beyond enabling the credit
required_evidence: Structure memo explaining non-tax commercial purpose
failure_consequence: Claim refused for the film credit entirely

structure_name: Related-party producer/overhead fee then reinvestment into same production
test: Bona fide commercial purpose test and misuse/abuse test both satisfied, independent of tax advantage
required_evidence: Written Revenue opinion/ruling on the specific fact pattern
failure_consequence: Tax advantage (the credit on the fee) denied or withdrawn with interest

structure_name: Deferred fee paid within four months then reinvested
test: Deferred sum actually paid no later than 4 months after completion
required_evidence: Payment date vs. completion/delivery-and-acceptance date
failure_consequence: Fee wholly non-qualifying (not a partial disallowance)

structure_name: Deferred fee paid within four months then reinvested
test: Payment is a real cash transfer not a book contribution or set-off of the receivable
required_evidence: Bank statements; general ledger entry cross-referenced to bank statement
authority_citation: Film Regulations 2019 Sch. 3(d)(iii); C&AG 2018 Report ¶18.41 (Revenue monitors claimed-but-unpaid amounts)
failure_consequence: Treated as claimed-but-not-paid; disallowed on Revenue review

structure_name: Deferred fee paid within four months then reinvested
statutory_or_regulatory_element: Same conditions as S1 or S2 by relatedness
test: Apply full S1 or S2 checklist rows depending on whether payee is connected
required_evidence: See S1/S2 rows
failure_consequence: See S1/S2 rows

structure_name: Fee proceeds recycled as the non-S.481 cash-financing contribution
test: Non-S.481 funding must be a real cash contribution not a re-routed fee
required_evidence: Full funding source trace; time-gap and independent-source evidence
failure_consequence: for example
column9: deferring fees"); Film Regulations 2019 Reg. 7(2); Sch. 1 Tab D
column10: Budgeted claim refused under s.481(2A)(b)(vii); financing condition treated as unmet

structure_name: Fee proceeds recycled as the non-S.481 cash-financing contribution
test: Confirm arrangement is not an artificial/circular financing structure
required_evidence: Schedule 1 Tab N confirmation; structure memo
authority_citation: Film Regulations 2019 Sch. 1 Tab N; TCA 1997 s.481(2A)(f)(ii)
failure_consequence: Producer company ceases to be regarded as a producer company; credit withdrawn

structure_name: Fee priced above market or contractually conditioned on reinvestment
test: Rate must not be inflated to cross-subsidize the equity leg
required_evidence: Independent market comparison predating any reinvestment discussion
failure_consequence: Fee reduced to market rate; budgeted claim barred if inflated

structure_name: Fee priced above market or contractually conditioned on reinvestment
test: No document conditions fee amount/payment on the reinvestment occurring
required_evidence: Absence of any side letter/term sheet linking the two legs
failure_consequence: Tax advantage denied on the fee under s.811C(4)

structure_name: State aid cumulation check (all structures)
statutory_or_regulatory_element: Cumulative aid intensity <=50% of production budget
test: Total S.481 + Screen Ireland + Sound & Vision + other public support does not exceed 50% (absent difficult/low-budget derogation)
required_evidence: Aggregate state-aid calculation across all funding sources
authority_citation: 2013 Cinema Communication ¶52 as applied in EC Decision SA.53399 recital 37; Screen Ireland State Aid Regulations & European Funding page
failure_consequence: Derogation required from Fís Éireann/Screen Ireland to the Department; scheme compliance at risk if exceeded

structure_name: Withholding check (all structures)
statutory_or_regulatory_element: Payee is not a non-EU/EEA artiste for artistic services
test: Confirm the fee is for producer/vendor services not disguised artiste payment
required_evidence: Role/service description; payee residency and entity type
authority_citation: TCA 1997 s.529B-M (Film Withholding Tax); Revenue FWT guidance
failure_consequence: 20% FWT withholding obligation arises if mischaracterized as an artiste payment
